summary: Iteration 2 covers the new admin-editable Site Settings feature plus regression on existing flows. Backend: 27/27 pytest passing including 3 new TestSiteSettings tests (GET returns all 12 fields with Truro/Nova Scotia/Canada defaults, PUT /api/admin/settings requires Bearer, PUT with admin JWT updates phone and GET reflects the change, then reverted). Frontend: public pages (Home, Footer, Contact) correctly display Truro · Nova Scotia · Canada and Canadian +1 902 phone via data-testid hero-location / footer-address / footer-email / footer-phone / contact-location-badge / contact-email / contact-phone / contact-address. Admin dashboard shows three tabs (admin-tab-team, admin-tab-gallery, admin-tab-settings). SettingsManager renders admin-settings-form with all 12 inputs (admin-settings-{field}). Edited phone via admin-settings-phone + admin-settings-save successfully persists through /api/settings and is reflected on /contact. No console errors, no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: settings_routes.PUT uses exclude_unset=True and strips strings — good. No ObjectId concerns (SQLAlchemy).
SiteSettings singleton is seeded once; consider adding a migration-safe upsert if new fields are added later.
SettingsManager refresh after save is handled via settings context; page reload/nav is enough (verified).
seed_data_creation: None — relied on seeded SiteSettings row populated from SITE_* env defaults. Test flow updated phone and reverted to the original value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings feature fully working end-to-end. 27 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (TestSiteSettings is new). Admin login selectors are data-testid admin-username / admin-password (there is no admin-login-submit testid; use the 'Sign in' button). Tabs: admin-tab-{team,gallery,settings}. Settings form uses admin-settings-form, admin-settings-{field_key}, admin-settings-save with a 'Site settings saved' toast on success.
